_comment: A land AURA cast in the SAME PLAN unlocks the colour it grants, for a LATER cast in that plan.
Board: Aether Hub under two Wild Growths (taps {C}{G}{G}), Conservatory (G/W), Brushland (G/W/C).
Hand: Trace of Abundance, Peregrine Drake, Mariposa Military Base. Nothing here makes BLUE, and
Peregrine Drake costs {4}{U}. The line is: play Mariposa, cast Trace of Abundance ({R/W}{G} -- the
{R/W} off Conservatory's white, the {G} off Brushland), which makes the enchanted land tap for one
mana of ANY colour, then cast the Drake off Hub(3) + Mariposa({C} + the Trace's any -> {U}).
Both colour gates (ComputeAvailableColors, BuildColorFeasibility) and the flat mana pool are built
ONCE per enumeration off the pre-plan board, where the Trace is still in hand -- so all three were
blind to it. The gates rejected the line as 'no untapped source produces blue mana' and the pool
read it as one mana short of a board that pays it EXACTLY. The line was deleted before the payer
ever saw it, in every game of every seed; the play viewer only made it say so out loud.
This is the deck's turn-3 route, so the assertion is deliberately BOTH halves:
* verdict != illegal proves the gates admit it, and
* expect_variants_all_contain pins that every surviving variant really casts the Drake --
the count alone would pass on two variants that both drop it.
The four variants are the genuine sub-decision of WHICH land the Trace enchants (Hub, Conservatory,
Brushland or Mariposa); all pay, because an empty land_aura_produces is 'one mana of any colour'
either way. This was 2 (Hub or Mariposa only) until the 2026-09-05 host-reservation fix: the
per-cast payment used to spend Conservatory/Brushland on the Trace's own {R/W}{G} whenever it was
the declared host, so those orderings dropped the Drake and CheckLine filtered them. Reserving the
declared host across the Aura's own payment (the realization twin of the reservation both
payability walks already made) makes every host's ordering really pay -- verified by the ordering
probe's ApplyPlanDirect, which is a real payment, not a bound.
MTG_UNPRUNED=1 is not decoration: the cast-ORDERING search is gated on UnprunedGate::SearchOrder,
so without it this fixture would not exercise the path the viewer runs on.
